narrative:
Vodafone Revenue in the Q3 Forecast is EUR 42.2B, +4.3% against the EUR 40.5B budget.

Germany is the largest segment at EUR 13.0B (31% of group). Türkiye is furthest ahead of plan (EUR 0.3B); Germany is furthest behind (EUR 0.1B).

Key risk: the Germany gap widens if the volume drivers on the Scenarios page move against plan.

signals.title: 7+5 forecast below budget — Germany is the largest gap
signals.source: SDP Revenue Planning — connections × ARPU by segment
signals.excerpt: The 7+5 forecast combines April–October actuals with the Snowflake ML forecast for November–March. Germany carries the largest gap to budget, while VodafoneThree and Türkiye run ahead.

signals.title: ML forecast retrained after the October close
signals.source: Snowflake ML FORECAST — segment revenue series
signals.excerpt: SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST was retrained on 31 months of segment revenue after the October close; the model proposes the November–March outlook with prediction intervals for planners to accept or override.

signals.title: Snowbots closed October overnight
signals.source: SDP Autopilot — Close Sentinel, Variance Explainer, Rolling Forecast
signals.excerpt: By 07:00 the Snowbots had reconciled the October SAP close, drafted the variance commentary and rolled the forecast; three approvals are waiting in the inbox.
